summary: Iteration 5 retest of the single outstanding bug from iteration 4 (missing ttsApi.config() call in Dashboard.jsx). Fix VERIFIED. Backend regression 7/7 pass (test_tts_did.py: /api/tts/config returns configured:true, /api/did/config returns configured:false as expected, /api/tts/speak returns 200 audio/mpeg, empty-text 400, unauthed 401). Frontend end-to-end: (1) /dashboard renders data-testid='voice-toggle-button' with title 'Silenciar voz de Elena' by default, header shows '· en línea · voz activa'; (2) clicking the toggle cycles title between 'Silenciar voz de Elena' and 'Activar voz de Elena'; (3) sending 'Hola Elena' via chat triggers EXACTLY one POST /api/tts/speak returning 200 audio/mpeg within ~10s; (4) header transitions to '· hablando con voz real' during audio playback; (5) with voice muted, sending another message fires 0 POSTs to /api/tts/speak over 30s (chat still streams); (6) /dashboard#session_id=fake-invalid-xyz shows data-testid='auth-unauthorized-message' with 'Acceso Restringido' + 'Cambiar de cuenta Google' button; (7) /login shows 'ENTRAR AL LOUNGE' button (data-testid='auth-login-google-button'). No regressions detected.
